blocks.text: P-pop group SB19 officially launched its photo book “Wakas at Simula: A Visual Journey” on Monday, Oct. 5, giving fans a look at behind-the-scenes moments from the group’s milestones. The launch, held at a mall in Ortigas, featured a book-signing session with fans, or A’TIN, as well as a brief question-and-answer with members of the press. The photo book contains previously unreleased photographs and anecdotes from the members, documenting their journey from the beginning of the “Wakas at Simula” era through its conclusion. “Mostly ‘yung laman ng book is photos that are not released or hindi pa nakita ng fans.
